intent: A resident of Gunbarrel or the folded-in place of Niwot searches for artificial turf and needs to know whose rules govern their yard before we quote anything: City of Boulder or unincorporated Boulder County, which water utility they're on, and whether any local board (HOA, design review committee) reaches a turf project.
distinctValue: Gunbarrel straddles the City of Boulder / unincorporated Boulder County line, so its water utility and its landscaping rules split by parcel; Niwot is fully unincorporated and stays on Left Hand water, so it inherits the county-code and Left-Hand-water half of the Gunbarrel page rather than needing a new set of rules, with one added wrinkle: Niwot's own Design Review Committee is real but advisory-only and geographically narrow, so it does not reach most Niwot yards.

sources.label: City of Boulder: water conservation
supports: the city has been on a Drought Watch since 1 April 2026: grass may be watered only in the morning before 10 or the evening after 6

sources.label: Left Hand Water District: drought
supports: April, 2026: The Left Hand Water District Board of Directors has declared Stage 1 (Mild) Water Shortage.
water supply remains adequate, but conditions are beginning to place moderate pressure on the District's supply relative to demand
restrictions in effect are voluntary, not mandatory

sources.label: Left Hand Water District: conservation
supports: Left Hand also runs a rebate program with Resource Central

sources.label: Wikipedia: Gunbarrel, Colorado
supports: residents formed the Gunbarrel Public Improvement District in 1993 out of concern about development next door

sources.label: Colorado SB23-178, signed act
supports: an HOA's design guidelines may regulate nonvegetative turf in the rear yard but not prohibit it

sources.label: Boulder County: Land Use Code
supports: The Land Use Code applies to all land within the unincorporated areas of Boulder County, not in cities or towns.

sources.label: Boulder County: Niwot Design Review Committee
supports: The committee covers the Niwot Rural Community District I (NRCD I)
The committee does not have legal authority to grant Certificates of Appropriateness.
